build: Post-launch mechanics described by the director in 2020
platform: Cross-platform behavior; source does not bind observations to one platform
observations: A jump remains available briefly after the character leaves a ledge.
A jump input can be retained until a valid landing window.
Near-corner head collisions can receive bounded positional correction.
Momentum from a moving platform can be retained for a later jump.
inferences: The allowances reduce failures where the player's intended decision is legible but execution misses a narrow timing or positioning boundary.
The movement can remain difficult because challenge geometry and decision sequence are preserved while selected input windows are widened.
limits: This record does not contain fresh frame measurements.
It does not establish ideal timing values for another game.
Critical reception is not treated as causal proof.
